citations.claim: The main application uses Hono web framework and imports key modules for Slack integration, Centaur handoff, and agent sessions
The application uses middleware for tracing, logging, timeout handling, and request ID generation
Slack event handler implements deduplication and background processing
CentaurHandoff class sends normalized events to Centaur workflow API with tracing
Event normalization transforms Slack events into standardized format with mention detection
AgentSessionRenderer manages streaming agent execution sessions with real-time updates
Final delivery poller runs every 2 seconds to claim and deliver completed workflow results
EventDeduper provides TTL-based deduplication for Slack webhook events
Configuration uses Zod schema for validating environment variables with defaults
Signature verification implements HMAC-SHA256 validation for Slack webhooks
OpenTelemetry integration provides distributed tracing with OTLP export
Logging system automatically redacts PII including emails, SSNs, and tokens
Runtime dependencies include Hono, Slack Web API, OpenTelemetry, and Zod
Health endpoints provide basic and readiness checks
Message API endpoints support posting, updating, and deleting Slack messages
Streaming API provides start, append, and stop operations for real-time messages
Agent session API manages execution sessions with text, step, and completion endpoints
Slack event processing includes authorization checks and normalization
Slack command handler integrates with Linear API for feedback issue creation
Slack reply limits define message size constraints for various content types
